purpose: Re-select a current-service guard on a fresh development population after correcting inclusive packet-deadline slot semantics, freeze it, then evaluate once on a disjoint fresh holdout population.

selection_rule.eligibility: For every development regime, the mean paired candidate-minus-reactive goodput difference must be >= -0.001 Mbps.
selection_rule.objective: Among eligible candidates, maximize the minimum across development regimes of the mean paired candidate-minus-reactive goodput difference.
selection_rule.tie_break_1: Choose the candidate with the smaller mean paired P95 latency difference across development regimes.
selection_rule.failure_rule: If no candidate is eligible, freeze no candidate and report that the current-service guard family failed the corrected development gate. Do not inspect holdout outcomes for selection.

holdout_rule: Evaluate exactly the frozen corrected-development-selected policy and reactive baseline on all fresh holdout seeds and regimes. Do not alter the guard ratio after holdout inspection.
evidence_note: This is a fresh synthetic revalidation necessitated by a packet-deadline discretization correction. The earlier 202611/202612-seed evidence is retained as historical pre-correction evidence and must not be presented as final corrected inference. This is not WOMD or measured-channel evidence.
